summary: Iteration 10 — Full regression across auth, contact (NEW), marketplace, mart, material calc, contractor BOQ, solar EPC, tenders, admin RBAC (13 sub-tabs) and billing (Stripe redirect). Backend regression suite: 19/19 tests PASS (test_regression_iter10.py). Frontend smoke: contact page shows phone +91 70072 54932 and all 3 offices (Gorakhpur/Gurugram/Vapi); POST /api/contact returns 200 and success toast displayed; Footer exposes footer-phone/footer-email/footer-offices with matching content ('Head Office: Gorakhpur, UP | Corporate Office: Gurugram, Haryana | Branch Office: Vapi, Gujarat'). Public pages /freelancers, /pricing, /marketplace (7 product cards), /mart (82 mart-trend-btn), /tenders, /solar (solar-estimator + epc-estimate), and /login forgot-password flow (link → forgot-email → forgot-sent) all render without errors. Authed flows: customer login → dashboard, nav-materials, nav-solar-epc, nav-billing (2 invoice-pay buttons), dash-logout works. Contractor BOQ tab shows boq-template-select + boq-pdf-btn. Admin login → Administration section exposes 13 rbac-tab-* sub-tabs (companies, departments, roles, matrix, assign, categories, branding, pricing/plans+commission, billing, materials [Super Mart admin], modules, menus, audit) — every tab clicks cleanly with 0 console errors, brand-save present on branding, admin-materials editor renders with Add row + inline editable rate. Iteration 8 & 9 previously PASSED features confirmed unchanged. No regressions found.

issues: Pre-existing (iter7/8/9) hydration warning: platform instrumentation injects <span x-excluded=true> inside <option> in template-select. Non-blocking, cosmetic. Fix: pass a plain string child (e.g., `{String(t.name)}`) instead of the interpolated expression.

action_items: (LOW) Silence <span>-in-<option> hydration warning in MaterialCalculator by wrapping template.name with String() (still open from iter7).
(LOW) Contractor BOQ template load still does 12 sequential POSTs — batch endpoint /api/erp/boq/bulk would improve perceived speed (from iter8).
critical_code_review_comments: /api/contact endpoint stores raw user-supplied name/message with no length cap and no rate limiting — trivial abuse vector for spam / DB bloat. Recommend: max_length via Pydantic Field(..., max_length=2000) on message and simple in-memory or Mongo TTL rate limit per IP.
ContactIn has no 'company' / 'source' field; if marketing wants to route enterprise leads, extend schema early. Currently only name/email/message/phone are captured.

Backend BASE_URL discovery in tests needed a fallback to /app/frontend/.env because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL isn't in the shell env — good to codify a conftest helper for future suites (added inline in test_regression_iter10.py).

Admin dashboard uses only 3 top-level nav items (Overview, Users&Roles, Administration, AuditLogs). The 13 rbac-tab-* sub-tabs are nested under Administration. This is fine, but data-testid naming diverges from other dashboards (nav-* vs rbac-tab-*); consider unifying for testability.

When re-testing Contact, verify data-testids: contact-name, contact-email, contact-message, contact-submit, contact-phone-link, contact-email-link, office-0/1/2, footer-phone/footer-email/footer-offices. For admin, use data-testid pattern rbac-tab-<companies|departments|roles|matrix|assign|categories|branding|pricing|billing|materials|modules|menus|audit>, brand-save inside rbac-tab-branding, admin-materials inside rbac-tab-materials. Backend regression: run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_regression_iter10.py -v` (19 tests). Solar EPC endpoint is /api/solar/epc/estimate (not /api/solar/estimate). Billing endpoints are /api/plans and /api/invoices/me (public_router). Branding is /api/branding (public GET).
rca of the issue: No blocking issue found. Only two pre-existing low-priority items carried over from iter7/8.
